description:
Percentile-based factor scores for a ticker.

Each score is a percentile rank (0-100) where higher values indicate
more bearish characteristics for that factor.

valuation_score.description: Valuation score (higher = more expensive = more bearish)
valuation_score.title: Valuation Score

profitability_score.description: Profitability score (higher = less profitable = more bearish)
profitability_score.title: Profitability Score

growth_score.description: Growth score (higher = negative/slowing growth = more bearish)
growth_score.title: Growth Score

leverage_score.description: Leverage score (higher = more levered = more bearish)
leverage_score.title: Leverage Score

quality_score.description: Quality score (higher = lower quality = more bearish)
quality_score.title: Quality Score

market_score.description: Market score (higher = higher beta/momentum issues = more bearish)
market_score.title: Market Score

title: FactorScores
